Messages.Author: Pat
Messages.Body:
On A's turn X, Arika (Meth A) Mind Rapes Valerius (Meth B).

On A's turn X + 1, Meth A burns the MR, untaps Valerius, and takes control
of him. Meth B is ousted during A's turn X + 1. What happens to Valerius at
the end of A's turn X + 1?

I believe that A loses control of him (card text), and he is removed from
the game, since B is ousted. Is this correct?

Thanks,
Pat

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 2 Jan 2007 20:24:58 -0500, "Pat"
<patric...@NOSPAMcomcast.net> wrote:

>On A's turn X, Arika (Meth A) Mind Rapes Valerius (Meth B).

>On A's turn X + 1, Meth A burns the MR, untaps Valerius, and takes control
>of him. Meth B is ousted during A's turn X + 1. What happens to Valerius at
>the end of A's turn X + 1?

Control returns to the ousted player, and the card is burned.

>I believe that A loses control of him (card text), and he is removed from
>the game, since B is ousted. Is this correct?

Yes.

Hmmm. I was thinking of the rulebook change that made all your
controlled cards be removed from the game when you are ousted, instead
of burned.

It seems that returning control of a card to an ousted player still
results in the card being burned, rather than removed from the game.

Seems mildly inconsistent to me, but I doubt it'd matter for much.

Wait.....if i control a minion, and Tension in the Ranks is in play, and
I am due to return control of that minion to an ousted player, do I lose
a pool when the minion burns?

Presumably I would have to, since the minion can't have been controlled
by the other, non-exisitng, methuselah in the mean time....
